integrity: The stiffness-limit formula and finite negative-axis witness are exact; density relies on the analytic irrational-rotation argument; earlier published stability analyses remain a residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar real decay, the specified three Gauss–Lobatto nodes, the stated implicit-Euler preconditioner, constant-stage initialization, exact rational sweeps and fixed timestep; the claim does not establish complex-plane A-stability of all sweep counts, nonlinear behavior, or adaptive-solver failure.
title: Half-density stiff instability of convergent three-node deferred-correction sweeps
